SPECIALS.//: V18 (carried 12-0 with Cam's yes, 20 October; all answers (a)/(b) as recommended): specials by class level, by weapon kind, and the bosses' signature weapons -- all paid from the one bar (the special bar, fury or devotion). A class special unlocks at its minLevel of CLASS level; a weapon special at `unlock` (the skill its weapon trains) and works for anyone holding that kind of weapon; a signature special works with that one weapon in hand. Up to `max` sit on the Kit's Combat tab, chosen from the catalogue on the Character sheet's Combat tab. fx: an effect put on the creature when the special lands (EFFECTS: kind, rounds, power). ignoreDef: the share of its Defence the special goes through. skin: a kill in a fight where it landed gives an extra hide or meat (the field-dressing list). Priced by the Mathematician's rule: about +25-40% damage a bar's worth, signature ones a little more.
